# Kohinoor Singh — Frontend Developer (MERN Stack) based in Karnal, Haryana, India

> https://kohinoorsingh.netlify.app/

## Bio
BCA Web Development student at Pt. Chiranji Lal Sharma Govt. P.G. College, Karnal.
Full-stack and frontend developer building FixFlow (a campus complaint workflow system in MERN) and Kohinoor Tunes (a free open-source music streaming application).
Specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS.
